name: 豹王之爪
description: 灵压。对4格内1名敌人连续攻击5次，每次造成75%攻击力的物理伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 4, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; var hits = 0; var total = 0; for (var index = 0; index < 5; index++) { var activeCaster = battle.pieces.find(function(piece) { return piece.instanceId === caster.instanceId && piece.currentHp > 0; }); var activeTarget = battle.pieces.find(function(piece) { return piece.instanceId === target.instanceId && piece.currentHp > 0; }); if (!activeCaster || !activeTarget) break; var hit = dealDamage(activeCaster, activeTarget, Math.floor(activeCaster.attack * 0.75), 'physical', battle, 'grimmjow-panther-claw'); hits++; total += hit.damage || 0; activeCaster = battle.pieces.find(function(piece) { return piece.instanceId === caster.instanceId && piece.currentHp > 0; }); if (activeCaster) dealDamage(activeCaster, activeCaster, 1, 'true', battle, 'grimmjow-destruction-instinct'); } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '以豹王之爪攻击' + hits + '次，共造成' + total + '点物理伤害' }; }
